0022600160.text: The Hawks (3-3, 1st in the Southeast and 6th in the East) are on a one-game winning streak and have gone 2-1 on the road, while the Pacers (2-4, 12th in the East) have lost three straight and are 0-2 at home. Atlanta is without Henri Veesaar (knee), Jock Landale (hip), and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture), and Indiana is missing Ben Sheppard (knee), Ivica Zubac (ankle sprain), Johnny Furphy (knee surgery), T.J. McConnell (hamstring strain), and Tyrese Haliburton (hamstring strain). The teams have not played each other yet in 2026-27, and the Hawks won the 2025-26 season series 2-1, though Indiana beat Atlanta 129-124 in Indianapolis in their most recent meeting on January 31, 2026.
